notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B search/productivity) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Team started with Hosted API for quick validation, now pushing to Dedicated POC for predictable throughput and lower per-vector cost.

Key business drivers:
- Improve search relevance across 1.2M documents, user-facing search for product discovery and support docs.
- Nightly batch embedding job to re-index changed docs (~1.2M vectors total; ~1536-dim target).
- Need 99th pct latency for user search < 250ms, peak concurrent queries ~500 qps across global region. Cost sensitivity: want predictable monthly commit vs burst pricing.

Technical requirements / constraints observed on calls:
- Vector DBs under consideration: Pinecone (preferred by infra), Milvus for on-prem experiments, Qdrant for dev. Integration points: bulk upsert API, async upsert callbacks, namespace/collections support.
- Batch job expectations: ingest 100k vectors/hour or faster for nightly windows; ability to do incremental upserts without re-ingesting full dataset.
- Embedding model candidates: open models (all-MiniLM, text-embedding-3-small) vs hosted high-quality; want local quantized embedder option in Dedicated to avoid egress and reduce unit cost.
- Routing: prefer to route read queries to cached replicas; fallbacks to smaller models acceptable for non-critical routes.
- Security: must pass SOC2 checklist, SSO via SAML + SCIM for provisioning, KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 12 months, EU data residency for EU customers.

POC scope (agreed):
- Phase 1 (hosted): validate embedding quality on 50k query set, baseline latency and recall@10; 2 weeks.
- Phase 2 (dedicated): spin a dedicated pool with GPU-backed embedder + vectorDB connector to Pinecone/Milvus; stress test to 500 qps, measure latencies and bulk upsert throughput; 3 weeks.
- Success metrics: recall@10 >= current baseline + 8-12%, median search latency < 150ms at 200 qps, sustained 500 qps with p95 < 300ms, nightly ingest within 8-hour window.

Notes from last demo (2025-12-01):
- Hosted API demo: small test index (25k vectors) returned median 95ms with 8ms embedding time using text-embedding-3-small. Team liked streaming/structured responses.
- Main ask: show bulk upsert throughput numbers with dedicated connector and warm-up guidance; price out a 3-month pilot with committed monthly GPUs.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal: DPA & security questionnaire outstanding (ticket SEC-1890).
- Infra: VPC peering needs network security sign-off; timeline unknown (internal IT).
- Pricing: LatticeWave needs clear committed vs burst pricing scenarios to present to finance — requested 3-tier pricing (pilot, scale, enterprise).

Phrases / direct quotes from customer: "We need predictable spend for search traffic spikes during product launches." / "If we can hit ingestion SLAs, we'll commit to Dedicated for production."

Artifacts: runbook + perf scripts in Drive, pricing spreadsheet shared (link). Jira tickets for network/security attached. SE Priya to run scaled perf POC week of 2025-12-08. AE Jordan to prepare pilot SOW and pricing by 2025-12-10.
